notes.title: My Demonic Romance 0.17.1 - Small update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43869514/ffb64b68bcae6c2499dc2bfd0722151e63b54cb9.png[/img]

The end of the year is always a little difficult for us and Release 0.18 of MDR isn't complete yet as we planned, it will be available in January. Sorry for that and thank you for your patience.Meanwhile, here is an update for MDR with some new content concerning the previous chapters of the game (2 new story scenes and 11 voiced lines), they are mainly there to improve the consistency of the story. And BTW the game is now available in Chinese!

We wish you a Merry Christmas and an Happy New Year!

Features:
[list]
[*] Chinese language available in options
[*] 2 story scenes
[olist][*] Mike's phone call (in the intro of the game)
[*] About the failed spell (in chapter 2 after watching Desdemona painting)[/olist]
[*] 11 voiced lines
[/list]

Have fun ;)

[b]Andrealphus[/b]
Have fun ;)

[b]Andrealphus[/b]
